items.en_title: Santo Antônio das Missões (RS) Health & medical procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 20 #0014
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Santo Antônio das Missões (RS) is procuring healthcare goods or services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 122,875.20; proposals close Nov 20, 23:59 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
